quest.title: Treasures and Collectors
quest.description: Try your luck at the Saurian Relics Excavation Site!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: Three hundred Mora entry fee...

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: The price is set by the Saurian Relics Association, and cannot be negotiated. As far as I know, this is already the cheapest excavation site, as it's been open the longest.

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: But nowadays, we sometimes get dreamers like you who want to try their luck.

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: After all, you never know! Maybe none of the hundreds and thousands of people who came before you had a good eye for treasure, and missed a priceless relic that only looks ordinary.

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: Many would pay 300 Mora for such a beautiful dream.

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: So, how lucky are you feeling? Do you believe you'll be the one to strike it rich?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrooo... Rawr! Rawr! Raaawr!

choices.text: My luck's never let me down.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Feel like putting your luck to the test, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He definitely looks up for it. And what's 300 Mora anyway? Paimon can handle that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Being able to buy three rays of hope for that sum is kind of a steal, really!

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: Then I wish you all the best of luck.

choices.text: I don't need that, I've got a lucky Saurian.
It's free if I beat you, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that's not how we normally do things!

talks.objective: Try your luck at the excavation site
Check the treasure that your Saurian companion found

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This little ball... It looks kinda like a component or something. You like it?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrah... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Though we didn't dig it up, since we did find it here... It might be something really valuable!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's ask when we leave!

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} found this...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: Let me have a look... Not the most uncommon item, but still, a rare find. It is very well-preserved, with clearly-visible phlogiston flow patterns.

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: Yes... Would you be willing to part with it if I gave you 10,000 Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha—!? Did we really find a priceless Saurian relic!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon just knew that {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} was awesome, and would bring us good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: No, this isn't nearly as precious as you seem to think. Were you to take it to Association headquarters for appraisal, it'd clock in at around 5,000 Mora at most.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not falling for that trick! If it's only worth 5,000, why are you willing to pay 10,000 for it?

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: That's because of the unique patterns on it. I'm quite taken with them. Though it may not be that valuable in the eyes of others, I'm willing to pay a bit extra for it.

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: You may call me eccentric, but you could also say it's just the nature of a collector.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... When you put it like that, Paimon gets you. And 10,000 is quite a lot compared to the entrance fee.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, shall we trade it in for 10,000?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroh... Rrrooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You don't seem too happy about that, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}... Do you wanna keep it for yourself?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrah... Rawr!

choices.text: Well, you were the one who found it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Since {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} doesn't want to sell, then we'll just have to keep it.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: #Looks like you value {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} far more than Mora.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Naturally! He's our companion, after all. But if we find something similar in the future...

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: Thank you, but a collector's passion is as fickle as the tides. It rises as suddenly as it might retreat. Perhaps I'll find myself obsessing over something else in the future, though I can't yet say what my new interest will be.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Rawr rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Are you agreeing with her, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Ohhh, Paimon gets it! This must be the mutual respect and understanding shared by collectors!

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: It is my honor to have been acknowledged by such a brilliant young Tepetlisaurus. Still, even if we can't do business, that doesn't mean we can't be friends! Feel free to come find me if you ever want to talk about collecting.

response.speaker: Quipia
response.text: I won't keep you any longer, then. Good luck!

choices.text: Guess you wanna be a collector too, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Quipia
dialogues.text: What is it? There's no time limit, so take your time.
